id: title:GeneralistDev:keep home sample labels inside cards

observations.behavior: Replaces a large inline tooltip and conditional wizard-status text with an imported SampleDataTag component.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the sample data placeholder in insight charts; this is not a query or ingestion change but a UI presentation update.

observations.behavior: Defines a new reusable tag component that displays "This is sample data" and optional setup status messages inside a Tooltip wrapper.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds shared behavior for displaying sample-data warnings across multiple chart locations without duplicating code.

observations.behavior: Removes the old conditional rendering of SampleDataState, replacing it with direct chart display while using adornment instead.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates HomeTabChartCard to no longer wrap charts in SampleDataState, relying on the new SampleDataTag placement strategy.

observations.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown: no backend, warehouse, or API diffs. No tests demonstrate runtime correctness or compatibility. Tier cannot distinguish between narrow maintenance and broader capability improvement.

review.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown: no backend, warehouse, or API diffs. No tests demonstrate runtime correctness or compatibility. Tier cannot distinguish between narrow maintenance and broader capability improvement.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive bounded improvement: extracting repeated sample-data warning markup into a shared SampleDataTag component and updating its usage across several chart components. This reduces duplication and standardizes how PostHog users see sample-data placeholders; however, this does not change query planning, ingestion, identity storage, or systemic reliability, so tier 3 is unsupported.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to user experience and maintainability of insight visualization; could reduce future regression risk when adding similar markers elsewhere.
review.uncertainty: Without backend or test execution results we do not know if behavior matches expectations or whether adoption has occurred.
